name: blueprint/agent-notebook
description: Durable agent memory over the store: notes under note:<slug>, recall by prefix scan, and LLM escalation only where it pays - rh_text_summarise to compact a long note, rh_text_extract to pull structured bits out of prose. The notes pattern from the catalogue, made a routine.
use_cases: pull dates and names out of prose
search my own notes by prefix
recipe: write: rh_store_put note:<slug> { text, tags, at } -> read: rh_store_get by slug -> scan: rh_store_list + prefix filter is the search -> compact: when a note grows past a cap, rh_text_summarise and store the short form alongside (keep the original) -> structured recall: rh_text_extract with a schema over one or more notes
result_kind: one store record per note, optional summary field

invoke_contract.write: { slug, text, tags? } -> { key, updatedAt, writes }

config_variants.structure: free prose | extract-on-recall with a fixed schema

cost_hint: free until compaction; one model call per summarise/extract
pitfalls: absence is { found: false } - the exists() check, not an error
the prefix IS the search: note:project:* enumerates a project; pick slugs that sort well
summarise compacts but never replaces the original - keep the full text as the source of truth
extract needs a JSON Schema and returns one conforming object - parse failures are clean errors
values must be JSON-serializable - no Dates, no functions, ISO strings only
local_limits: search is prefix-scan only - no free-text search without building an index
cloud_limits: store domain is the harness's; a Cloudflare KV index is the documented escalation for free-text search
